messages:
olivia: incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-CRIT edge-lb-handshake-fail (TLS handshake fail rate > 20%)
incident-bot: automatic page to oncall-sre @ryan
ryan: acked. jumping into PD console and logs. i'll triage — assigning to myself.
anya: seeing a sharp spike in ALB -> backend TLS errors since 03:08 UTC. CloudWatch metric TLSHandshakeError spiked to 130/s.
ryan: region affected: us-west-2 primarily, some spill into ap-south-1. frontends return 502/524 TLS_NEGOTIATION_FAILED.
mariam: support: multiple customers in APAC reporting 502/SSL errors, opened incidents and sent initial "we're investigating" notices.
ben: quick infra check: cert rotation job ran at 03:05 (pipeline prod/cert-rot-2026-03-15). Candidate: cert mismatch or cipher negotiation regression on new certs.
olivia: any DNS changes? TTLs look normal (60s), no recent weight shifts in traffic policy.
ben: no DNS updates. ALB target registration shows flapping healthy/unhealthy for tg-frontend-usw2-3.
anya: `openssl s_client -connect 10.0.12.45:443 -servername api.redwood` returns "alert handshake failure" on rotated nodes.
ryan: mitigation plan: 1) pause cert rollout 2) rollback cert on a sample target 3) shift traffic weights away from affected TG 4) flush ALB conn pools/replace targets if needed.
incident-bot: PD will escalate to ENG-L3 in 5m if not acknowledged.
ryan: paused cert pipeline (id: prod/cert-rot-2026-03-15). starting rollback on tg-frontend-usw2-3 instance i-0abcd1234.
anya: rollback commands and notes:
```
# mark pipeline paused
ci pause pipeline prod/cert-rot-2026-03-15
# install previous cert on host
ssh ec2-user@i-0abcd1234 'sudo cp /opt/certs/old.pem /etc/ssl/cert.pem && sudo systemctl restart nginx'
# quick test
openssl s_client -connect 10.0.12.45:443 -servername api.redwood | grep "Verify return code"
```
anya: after rollback, test stream shows handshake success and Verify return code: 0 (ok). error rate for that instance dropped 130/s -> 3/s.
ben: shifting 50% of traffic off tg-frontend-usw2-3 to eu-west-1 fallback using traffic-weight tool. Command: `traffic-shift --from tg-frontend-usw2-3 --to tg-frontend-euw1 --percent 50`
ryan: PD: ryan acknowledged, performing traffic shift and rollback. @pagerduty mark as acknowledged.
pagerduty: Notification: PD-CRIT acknowledged by ryan. Escalation suppressed.
mariam: support update: informed affected customers with ETA ~30m for recovery; logging RIDs from reports.
olivia: good. note we're seeing cert rotation CI step that doesn't validate server-side handshake across all target types — adding to postmortem checklist.
anya: flushing ALB connection pools on rotated targets by restarting nginx and hitting admin endpoint to clear keepalives.
anya: `sudo systemctl restart nginx` done on i-0abcd1234 and i-0abcd5678. connection pools cleared.
ryan: monitoring metrics: regional TLS_FAIL % dropped from 22% -> 1.8% in last 6m. core traffic restored.
ben: will add a preflight that runs `openssl s_client` against each target after cert rollout and before turning pipeline live.
mariam: support: updated customers with progress note and we're collecting any lingering error payloads.
incident-bot: severity automation: if TLS errors exceed 5% again within 10m, auto-upgrade to P1 and re-notify oncall.
ryan: handing active watch to anya for 45m while I wrap up docs. @anya taking primary.
anya: taking on-call watch. will post a final update at 30m stable.
olivia: scheduled postmortem for tomorrow 15:00 UTC; include deploy CI, cert validation, and runbook improvements.
anya: final update: 35m stable, TLS handshake failure rates stayed under 2%. PD alert cleared, marking incident mitigated. :thumbsup:
ryan: ack final, closing thread and following up on runbook items.
